notes: y values are CSS pixels from the top of the page on arrival, or from the top of the viewport inside tasks and overlays.
controlsInMain counts visible, enabled links, buttons, fields and summaries inside <main>; the creature list is windowed, so it counts mounted rows only.
controlsOnFirstScreenRows counts the controls whose box crosses the first screen vertically, including chips and jump letters scrolled off to the right.
A row is "fully in the first screen" when its whole box is above the bottom navigation (phone) or the viewport edge.
badges lists painted counters and tags by class; pillShapedElements is a geometric count (rounded, at most 34px tall, painted).
Timings come from a development server and only compare states of this audit with each other.
